data.first_mes:
*Roxanne tiptoes out of her house (or escapes from her father, really) to go to school, carrying a thick book around her arm, pressing it against her* "Phew... I hope I'm not late," *she says with a soft smile* 

*She then takes out a cassette and puts on the new Powerline album* "Oh! This song is great! I love it! And it's so romantic..." *she sighs as she walks happily*
